## 2. Core Disciplines & Offerings
1. Luxury Residential Architecture & Construction: Bespoke modern-minimalist, contemporary-tropical, and modern-classical estates.
2. Commercial Landmarks & Fit-Out: Flagship corporate headquarters, showrooms, modern clinics, and luxury hospitality venues.
3. Master Planning & Spatial Programming: Land profiling, drone topography, acoustic planning, and passive bioclimatic design.
4. General Contracting & Turnkey Execution: Complete civil, structural, architectural, and MEP engineering under strict Kurva-S timelines.

## 3. Engineering Tolerances & Physical Standards
- Concrete Grade: ReadyMix SNI K-350 with onsite slump cone testing per mixer truck.
- Anti-Seismic Reinforcement: Double bendrat wire tie with custom rebar spacers ensuring zero honeycomb void.
- Digital Laser Alignment: 90° corner angles verified with laser deviance strictly under 1mm.
- Marble Bookmatching: Italian Statuario, Botticino, and Travertine precision vein matching with flush jointing.
- Waterproofing: 3mm torch-on bituminous membrane on all exposed flat roofs, wet areas, and planter boxes with 48-hour flood test.
- Pre-Cast MEP Integration: Electrical conduits and sanitary piping pre-installed prior to slab casting.

## 4. 10-Step Master Construction Methodology
1. Initial Consultation: Aligning spatial vision, scope, operational standards, and initial budget parameters.
2. Precision Site Analysis: Topographical surveying, aerial drone mapping, and soil bearing capacity testing (sondir).
3. Bespoke Financial Engineering: Transparent itemized Bill of Quantities (RAB) with internal Unit Price Analyses (AHS) and zero hidden fees.
4. Collaborative Commitment: Signing of legally binding Construction Contract (SPK) with complete technical specifications.
5. Strategic Integrated Kick-off: Formulation of strict Kurva-S schedule and multi-discipline coordination meeting.
6. Real-Time Progress Stewardship: Daily photographic dispatch and systematic weekly progress reports via private WhatsApp group.
7. Material Curation & Verification: Strict sample approvals and laboratory/onsite verification before installation.
8. Signature Quality Control: Civil engineer oversight ensuring laser 90° alignment and MEP embedment.
9. Grand Handover: Collaborative client-architect-contractor inspection and official Handover Deed (BAST) signing.
10. Post-Construction Stewardship: 100-day retention maintenance warranty and 5-year structural guarantee.

## 5. Official Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q1: Apa keunggulan dan spesialisasi utama ww.cons di Surabaya?
A1: ww.cons memadukan estetika arsitektur modern-tropis dengan rekayasa sipil berstandar SNI K-350, toleransi siku laser 90° deviasi < 1mm, dan transparansi penuh tanpa biaya tersembunyi.

Q2: Standar mutu beton dan kontrol kualitas apa yang diterapkan?
A2: Beton ReadyMix SNI K-350 dengan pengujian slump mandiri per truk mixer, pembesian anti-seismik kawat ganda, dan garansi zero honeycomb.

Q3: Bagaimana transparansi anggaran biaya (RAB) dan kontrak kerja?
A3: RAB disusun rinci berbasis AHS terbuka, tanpa biaya tersembunyi, dilindungi SPK berkekuatan hukum dengan pembayaran bertahap berbasis kurva progres.

Q4: Apakah ww.cons membantu pengurusan PBG dan SLF?
A4: Ya, menyediakan kalkulasi struktur bersertifikat dan dokumen teknis lengkap untuk PBG dan SLF di Surabaya, Sidoarjo, dan Gresik.

Q5: Berapa lama masa garansi yang diberikan?
A5: Masa retensi pemeliharaan 100 hari dengan tim respons cepat, plus garansi struktur hingga 5 tahun.

Q6: Wilayah mana saja yang dilayani?
A6: Surabaya metropolitan (Citraland, Graha Famili, Pakuwon City, Dharmahusada), Sidoarjo, Gresik, Malang, Bali, dan Jakarta.
